title: Car Loan Traps Explained

scenes.text: A $32,000 car loan at 6% can cost $4,500 in interest over five years
scenes.query: 32,000 car loan 6% interest five years total cost

scenes.label: PAY MORE THAN MINIMUM
scenes.text: Paying just the minimum adds roughly $1,200 extra interest on a typical 60‑month loan
scenes.query: minimum payment extra interest auto loan 60 months
scenes.query2: auto loan interest extra cost minimum payment

scenes.label: UPSIDE‑DOWN LOAN
scenes.text: If you owe more than the car’s value after 24 months, you’re upside‑down and may lose money if you trade in early
scenes.query: upside down car loan after 24 months statistic

scenes.label: PAY OFF QUICKLY
scenes.text: Adding $100 extra each month can shave off a year and save around $800 in interest on a $20,000 loan
scenes.query: extra $100 per month auto loan interest saved
scenes.query2: auto loan early payoff savings example

scenes.text: Follow if you're done staying broke.

description: Avoid hidden costs that drain your wallet when financing a car. These three steps keep you in the driver’s seat of savings.
